Burgh used this warehouse until
two years ago!{VAR BE01}
When Burgh gets artist's block,
he comes back here to Nacrene City!

A lot of items have effects when Pokémon
hold them, so try to find them!{VAR BE01}
Well, work hard to fill up your Pokédex!
Good luck!

Then, what is the Pokémon you chose
at the beginning of your journey?

If you want to tell me, please speak
to me!
